mechanism: Piroxicam displaces sodium valproate from protein binding, increasing free (active) valproate levels and toxicity risk; additionally, NSAIDs may inhibit valproate metabolism and increase GI bleeding risk.
action: Monitor valproate levels closely, assess for signs of valproate toxicity (tremor, ataxia, confusion), and consider alternative analgesia; if combination necessary, use lowest NSAID dose for shortest duration with gastroprotection.
